items.title: Dick Spottswood interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 13, 2023
items.q: I’m working on a project for GHB Records out of New Orleans, that’s Lars Edegran, I’m sure you all know each other, that is going to consist of all of the surviving Ma Rainey records

ctx.x: Some years ago I went to the Belfer Audio Archive at Syracuse University, which is just down the road. And they were showing me the different devices, the Edison Diamond Disks and the cylinders and 78 players. And almost casually they said something about the controversy of cleaning up recordings like that so that they don’t sound like they used to. So they’re able to take out the hiss and the scratch and the almost built-in sound of the technology at the time. And that some people came down on the side of leave…

Well as it happens you landed me right in the middle of the project that’s been occupying a large number of my waking hours over the past couple of months so here it is, it’s time for the commercial. I’m working on a project for GHB Records out of New Orleans, that’s Lars Edegran, I’m sure you all know each other, that is going to consist of all of the surviving Ma Rainey records that anyone could find, and that includes outtakes, it even includes outtakes from “C.C. Ryder” with Louis Armstrong, that very…
